import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, fisher_exact
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import statsmodels.api as sm
x=pd.read_csv('sensors.csv'); y=pd.read_csv('labels.csv'); yy=(y.label==1).astype(int).values
t=pd.to_datetime(y.timestamp); n=len(y)
# time deciles, timestamp rank prevents duplicate issue
bins=pd.qcut(t.rank(method='first'),10,labels=False)
rec=[]
for c in x:
 a=x[c]; valid=a.notna(); a0=a[(yy==0)&valid];a1=a[(yy==1)&valid]
 if a.nunique(dropna=True)<=1 or len(a1)<5: continue
 # regular stats
 try: p=mannwhitneyu(a1,a0,alternative='two-sided').pvalue
 except: p=np.nan
 auc=roc_auc_score(yy[valid],a[valid])
 # missing fisher
 tab=[[int(((yy==1)&~valid).sum()), int(((yy==1)&valid).sum())],[int(((yy==0)&~valid).sum()),int(((yy==0)&valid).sum())]]
 pm=fisher_exact(tab).pvalue
 # within time bins median impute and fit logistic with time fixed effects, sensor+missing
 z=a.copy(); z=(z-z.mean())/z.std(); z=z.fillna(0.)
 design=pd.DataFrame({'z':z,'missing':(~valid).astype(int)})
 design=pd.concat([design,pd.get_dummies(bins,drop_first=True,dtype=float)],axis=1)
 try:
  fit=sm.GLM(yy,sm.add_constant(design),family=sm.families.Binomial()).fit()
  pa=float(fit.pvalues['z']); om=float(fit.params['z']); pms=float(fit.pvalues['missing']); oms=float(fit.params['missing'])
 except Exception as e: pa=om=pms=oms=np.nan
 rec.append(dict(sensor=c,missing=int((~valid).sum()),mean_good=a0.mean(),mean_bad=a1.mean(),median_good=a0.median(),median_bad=a1.median(),mw_p=p,auc=auc,auc_abs=max(auc,1-auc),missing_p=pm,adjust_p=pa,adjust_or=np.exp(om) if np.isfinite(om) else np.nan, miss_adjust_p=pms,miss_adjust_or=np.exp(oms) if np.isfinite(oms) else np.nan))
df=pd.DataFrame(rec)
for col in ['mw_p','missing_p','adjust_p','miss_adjust_p']:
 df[col+'_fdr']=multipletests(df[col].fillna(1),method='fdr_bh')[1]
print('Timestamps ordered',t.is_monotonic_increasing, 'per date defect rate top')
print(pd.crosstab(t.dt.date,yy).assign(rate=lambda q:q.get(1,0)/q.sum(axis=1)).sort_values('rate',ascending=False).head(20).to_string())
print('\\nTop raw MW')
print(df.sort_values('mw_p')[['sensor','missing','median_good','median_bad','auc','mw_p','mw_p_fdr','adjust_or','adjust_p','adjust_p_fdr']].head(30).to_string(index=False))
print('\\nTop adjusted value')
print(df.sort_values('adjust_p')[['sensor','missing','median_good','median_bad','auc','mw_p','mw_p_fdr','adjust_or','adjust_p','adjust_p_fdr']].head(30).to_string(index=False))
print('\\nTop missing effects')
print(df.sort_values('missing_p')[['sensor','missing','missing_p','missing_p_fdr','miss_adjust_or','miss_adjust_p','miss_adjust_p_fdr']].head(30).to_string(index=False))
df.to_csv('/tmp/secom_univariate.csv',index=False)
